Experience the charm of urban living in this stunning apartment located at 75 Dupont Street in Brooklyn. Enjoy spacious interiors, high-end finishes, and an abundance of natural light, making it an ideal sanctuary in the heart of the city.


The actual rent may vary based on lease terms. The NYC Rent Guidelines Board approved rent increases for rent-stabilized apartments of:

For one-year leases, there is a 3% increase commencing on or after October 1, 2025, and on or before September 30, 2026,

and a 4.5% increase for a two-year lease commencing on or after October 1, 2025, and on or before September 30, 2026.


Tenants are responsible for electricity including electric stove and heat.
